content:
Apple於昨日發布咗一個以安全性為重點嘅更新之後，而家已經詳細列出Safari 26.6.1嘅安全修正內容。以下係相關細節。

Codex喺多個CVE鳴謝名單中重複出現

Apple今日更新咗佢嘅「Apple security releases」網頁，詳細列出Safari 26.6.1所包含嘅錯誤修正。呢個更新而家已經可以畀macOS Sonoma同macOS Sequoia嘅用家使用。

根據文件內容，呢次更新合共修補咗22個CVE，全部都同WebKit有關，其中兩個漏洞涉及「處理惡意製作嘅網頁內容，可能導致記憶體損毀」。

值得留意嘅係，同近期嘅安全更新一樣，OpenAI Codex Security喺名單入面出現咗九次，進一步凸顯咗AI工具喺協助發掘Apple軟件安全漏洞方面嘅角色越嚟越重要。

以下係Apple提供嘅Safari 26.6.1完整安全內容：

Safari 26.6.1 Released 18 August 2026 WebKit Available for: macOS Sonoma and macOS Sequoia Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected Safari crash Description: An out-of-bounds read issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. WebKit Bugzilla: 317632 CVE-2026-64784: Janggoon Lee (Out of Bounds), OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 313452 CVE-2026-43795: wwwlk WebKit Bugzilla: 318348 CVE-2026-65338: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to memory corruption WebKit Bugzilla: 318405 CVE-2026-65341: Henock Habte WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved locking. WebKit Bugzilla: 321480 CVE-2026-64782: Seonwook Kim, Shubham Chaskar, lattice, Josef Korbel WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved input validation. WebKit Bugzilla: 321484 CVE-2026-64781: Thomas Guillem WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 321517 CVE-2026-65351: Niels Hofmans WebKit Bugzilla: 316996 CVE-2026-65340: Claudio Bozzato and Francesco Benvenuto (Cisco Talos), Josef Korbel (Citadelo) WebKit Bugzilla: 317142 CVE-2026-65337: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317349 CVE-2026-65336: Josef Korbel WebKit Bugzilla: 316723 CVE-2026-65335: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317603 CVE-2026-65333: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317450 CVE-2026-65332: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Bugzilla: 317611 CVE-2026-65331: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process crash Description: A use-after-free issue was addressed with improved memory management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316347 CVE-2026-64715: Hossein Lotfi (@hosselot) of TrendAI Zero Day Initiative WebKit Description: The issue was addressed with improved checks. WebKit Bugzilla: 316918 CVE-2026-64780: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved state management. WebKit Bugzilla: 316791 CVE-2026-65334: OpenAI Codex Security – Amy Burnett WebKit Description: A memory corruption issue was addressed with improved memory handling. WebKit Bugzilla: 317317 CVE-2026-43794: Dung Do (@_piers2) of Calif.io WebKit Impact: Processing maliciously crafted web content may lead to an unexpected process termination WebKit Bugzilla: 313703 CVE-2026-64787: 杉山 壮太, Shubham Chaskar WebKit History Impact: Visiting a maliciously crafted website may lead to sensitive data exposure WebKit Bugzilla: 315528 CVE-2026-64778: Mohit Negi WebKit Storage WebKit Bugzilla: 321485 CVE-2026-64779: Shubham Chaskar, Tommy DeVoss (of Braze Security Team, @thedawgyg) Additional recognition WebKit We would like to acknowledge Henock Habte for their assistance.
